profile.headline: Graphics Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a Graphics Software Engineer focusing on performance and quality in modern game development.

Skills: C/C++, DirectX11/DirectX12

positions.title: PC Graphics Engineer (Contract - Ascendion)
positions.description:
Halo Infinite
- Worked with multiple teams to identify and implement key features 
and optimizations to create a first-rate experience for PC players.
- Implemented Pipeline State Caching for DirectX12 to drastically 
improve PC platform loading times and in-game performance. 
- Acted as a computer platform Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Esports 
events providing on-site technical support to prioritize player and 
viewer experiences.
- Maintained compatibility for a wide range of hardware and driver 
configurations to confidently support as many different players as 
possible.
positions.insights: Skills: DirectX · Debugging · C++ · PC Games

positions.title: Graphics Programmer
positions.description:
Academic Project
Project Hydra - 3D Graphics and Audio Library

- Created graphics engine using DirectX12 and DirectX Raytracing to support library rendering functionality.
- Developed editor tools for creating and modifying raytraced scenes.
- Added support for graphics cards without accelerated raytracing to target more platforms.

positions.title: Lead Graphics Programmer
positions.description:
Academic Project
Zooplins - 3D Multiplayer Game

-Created graphics engine using C++ and DirectX11 allowing team members to load in assets and display them in game. 
- Implemented physically based rendering and image-based lighting models for more realistic rendering results.
- Developed editor tools allowing designers to easily created UI and edit graphics in game scenes.

positions.title: Gameplay Programmer
positions.description:
Academic Project
Punk Stereo - 2D Cooperative Platformer Game

- Organized 4 programmers and delegated tasks using Scrum board to keep team on track and meet deadlines.
- Created graphics engine using C++ and OpenGL allowing artists to load assets and display them in game.
- Programmed gameplay mechanics to create core game experience and allow for designer iteration.

positions.title: Gameplay Programmer
positions.description:
Academic Project
Cactimonium - 2D Cooperative Driving Game

- Programmed cooperative gameplay and enemy behaviors using C to create main game experience.
- Organized 5 team members and assigned technical tasks to maintain team progress and meet deadlines.

educations.degreeName: BS in Computer Science in Real-Time Interactive Simulation
